title: Polynomial-Time Reduction from a Language in P
statement: Let $L$ and $L'$ be languages of finite binary strings, with $L'\in\mathsf{P}$. If there are binary strings $a\in L$ and $b\notin L$, then $L'$ is polynomial-time many-one reducible to $L$.
hypotheses_covered: $L,L'$ are languages over the binary alphabet
